source_context.item_title: The Cross Top creates a protected driving environment with its wrap‑around, negative‑angle windscreen. It cuts wind chill and spray, improves visibility, and reduces glare and droplet buildup for a clearer view in all conditions.

source_context.item_title: The spacious cockpit layout brings people together with generous seating, open movement, and clear sightlines across the boat. Whether cruising, anchoring, or hosting guests, the cockpit offers a welcoming space for long days on the water.

images.title: AX45_XT_Efoil_Q9A8400
images.scope_evidence: Título del modelo: 'AX45_XT_Efoil_Q9A8400'.

source_context.item_title: The helm is shaped for confident control in all conditions. A wide dashboard, ergonomic controls, and excellent visibility support relaxed, focused driving. Combined with the smooth, balanced hull, it creates a commanding yet comfortable experience on every journey.

images.title: AX45_XT_Efoil_Q6A8829
images.scope_evidence: Título del modelo: 'AX45_XT_Efoil_Q6A8829'.

source_context.item_title: The aft U-sofa forms a natural gathering point right at the water’s edge. The cushions and wraparound layout make it ideal for dining, sunbathing, or enjoying time at anchor. The generous aft deck and easy access to the water elevate both comfort and usability.

source_context.item_title: Every space on the Cross Top is designed to feel bright, spacious, and calm. High-quality materials, refined ergonomics, and smart storage solutions create a practical and comfortable environment for longer adventures. The result is a versatile boat built for extended days onboard.
